alarm_threshold_v.title: Alarm threshold (V)
alarm_threshold_v.description: Vin below this is a dangerous undervoltage once it persists for the minimum low-voltage duration; the undervoltage flag latches until an external enable_vout confirmation

min_low_voltage_duration_s.title: Minimum low-voltage duration (s)
min_low_voltage_duration_s.description: Minimum time Vin must stay below the alarm threshold before it counts as an undervoltage

battery_backup_threshold_v.title: Battery backup threshold (V)
battery_backup_threshold_v.description: Vin below this means the controller is running on WBMZ-BATTERY backup power: Vout is left untouched and the undervoltage flag is not raised. 0 disables this exception

adc_poll_period_s.title: ADC poll period (s)
adc_poll_period_s.description: How often Vin is read from the ADC

adc_error_threshold.title: ADC error threshold
adc_error_threshold.description: Number of consecutive failed Vin reads treated as an undervoltage (fail-safe)

heartbeat_period_s.title: Heartbeat period (s)
heartbeat_period_s.description: How often the heartbeat control is published
